budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Escort two living supply carts to the east edge while allocating directional shielding, energy, repairs and movement.
task.natural_termination: Every cart is delivered or destroyed, or every escort is disabled; otherwise truncate at 80 nonterminal steps.
task.interaction: A facing-matched three-cell shield intercepts a projectile before it can damage a teammate or supply cart, consuming one charge. Nearby charge donors change future blocking and repair opportunities. Escort, guard, transfer and repair occupy the same action slot. Carts advance only with nearby escort requests.
task.observation_access: All entity positions and declared attributes are public. Role identity is self information. Fixed maps, constant labels and redundant derived geometry add no hidden information. Only native observations and legal masks enter a learner.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Number of projectiles intercepted by each role this step
Charge units sent by each role this step
Charge units received by each role this step
Hits on each role this step
Hits on each supply cart this step
Each cart escorted one cell east this step
Each cart newly arrived alive at the east edge this step
Projectile slots newly spawned this step

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
